newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Not all rolling finished yet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Not all rolling finished yet.

text.p: Most investors had either exercised or rolled February equity options positions out to farther months by Friday, but some stragglers were still busy, traders said.
Some of the biggest volume was done in blocks from investors rolling positions out of February options, which officially expire Saturday.
On the Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE), for instance, Texas Instruments Inc options were the most heavily traded, with much of the volume expiration-related.
The February 60 call traded about 7,340 contracts and the March 60 call and put each traded 7,100.
The Texas Instruments February 60 put traded 4,100.
The stock was down 2-3/8 at 79-1/4 in afternoon trading.
"Nothing was opened, it was all a roll," a trader said of the heavy Texas Instruments options activity.
On the American Stock Exchange (AMEX), an investor rolled a sizable position in the Safeway Inc February 42-1/2 call to the March 42-1/2 calls, traders said.
Safeway shares were down 3/8 at 47-7/8 in late trade.
Outside of the few big volume rolls, traders said activity was relatively quiet.
"There was a little flurry of activity this morning, but its quieted down since," one broker in Chicago said.
He added that some investors with low-priced February options were holding on to their positions in the hope of some late session pop.
"But it never happens," he said. "We had some people that did rolls, but most of it was done at the end of last week or the beginning of this week."
